name: What is the typical timeline for building a custom home?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for building a custom home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for custom home construction varies significantly based on design complexity, site conditions, permitting, and material selections. Generally, a custom home project from initial design to move-in can take anywhere from 12 to 24 months. The design and architectural phase typically accounts for 3-6 months, while the actual construction phase can range from 9-18 months. Unforeseen issues like weather delays or supply chain disruptions can extend this, so planning for flexibility is advisable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom home construction typically takes 12 to 24 months from design to move-in, depending on project complexity and site conditions.
